title: Always Be Moving
opening: Everyday activity can offer useful movement, but the main task sets the limit. A safe walk during a routine call may fit. Walking between heavy sets can get in the way, so rest can be the better choice.

modes.label: Routine call
modes.description: On a familiar, safe route, walking can fit a call that needs no notes if you can still take part comfortably. It is an opportunity, not a requirement.

modes.label: Difficult review
modes.description: A difficult review that needs close listening and notes may work better seated. Movement fits only when it leaves the main task intact.

modes.label: Between heavy sets
modes.description: Movement between heavy sets can impair the planned set. Rest can preserve the intended work; the framework does not require movement between sets.

choices.label: A possible conflict with the main task
Rest can be the right choice

statements.text: A safe walk during a routine call may fit if the person can still participate comfortably.
statements.feedback: The fit depends on the route being safe and movement leaving the call intact.

statements.text: Walking during a difficult review that needs notes can compete with the main task.
statements.feedback: When close listening and writing matter, sitting may preserve the task better.

statements.text: Rest between heavy sets can preserve the intended work when extra movement could impair the set.
statements.feedback: Rest belongs in the framework. The name does not require movement between sets.

statements.text: Always Be Moving means adding movement to every free minute, even when it interrupts another task.
statements.feedback: The source calls for compatible movement, not movement at every opportunity. Leave a difficult task, unsafe moment or needed rest alone.

ownPursuit.prompt: Pick a familiar day. Identify one safe interval where appropriate movement might fit and one interval to leave unchanged. Keep the main task and recovery in view.
ownPursuit.prediction: When do you expect movement to fit without competing with the main activity? What makes you expect that?
ownPursuit.observation: What would show that movement is safe and the activity remains comfortable, or that it is interfering?
ownPursuit.revision: If movement worsens the main task or recovery, what would you change or leave unchanged?
